name: model-declines-without-an-exact-token
pins: Step (c) of the confirmation reading order. "not that one, thanks" carries no exact token, so code cannot read it — but it plainly means no, and a decline that was never heard leaves the patient re-asked forever. The model's permitted verdicts are decline and non-answer only; it can never confirm. So this turn must clear the proposal and return to slot selection while booking nothing.

turns.message: I need a cardiology appointment next week
